name: read_chunked
title: Read Binary Data in Chunks
description: Reads a region of the currently selected data source in fixed-size chunks for pagination. Call repeatedly with increasing chunk_index until has_more is false to read regions larger than the single-read limit.

address.description: Start address of the region to read

size.description: Total size of the region to read. Defaults to the rest of the data source

chunk_size.description: Size of each chunk in bytes (4KiB to 16MiB)

chunk_index.description: Zero-based index of the chunk to read

handle.description: Handle of the data source the data was read from

chunk_address.description: Address of the first byte of this chunk

chunk_data_size.description: Number of bytes in this chunk

total_chunks.description: Total number of chunks in the requested region

has_more.description: Whether more chunks are available after this one
